pcd.measureLink: Don't know PCD? Calculate from hole measurement

pcdMeasure.title: Bolt Circle PCD from Measurement
pcdMeasure.instructionsSubtitle: Method for measuring center-to-center distance (C) using digital calipers
pcdMeasure.step1Desc: Use the caliper jaws to measure the diameter of one of the bolt holes.
pcdMeasure.step2Desc: While the caliper jaws are set to the hole diameter d, press the ZERO / ORIGIN button.
pcdMeasure.step3Title: 3. Measure outer distance between adjacent holes
pcdMeasure.step3Desc: Place the caliper jaws on the outermost edges of two adjacent holes. The zero offset automatically subtracts hole diameter d — the reading is exactly center-to-center distance (C)!
pcdMeasure.step4Desc: Enter distance C and hole count N to immediately calculate the precise pitch circle diameter (PCD).
pcdMeasure.caliperTipDesc: With a manual/vernier caliper: measure outer edge distance Lzew and subtract hole diameter (C = Lzew - d), or inner edge distance Lwew and add hole diameter (C = Lwew + d).
pcdMeasure.cHelp: Reading from outer edges on zeroed caliper
pcdMeasure.unzeroedDesc: Enter hole diameter and edge measurement to automatically calculate center-to-center distance C.
pcdMeasure.waiting: Enter hole count N and center distance C to calculate PCD
pcdMeasure.caliperMeasurement: Caliper outer measurement after zeroing on d = C
